nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Hierarchical Bayesian regression normative modeling in PCNToolkit (version 0.18).
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: Hierarchical Bayesian regression analysis was employed to accommodate intersite variation and generate normative models using the covariates of sex, age, and education.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Cortical thickness (CT) of the anterior cingulate cortex (ACC) and its subdivisions: dorsal ACC (dACC, BA24), subgenual ACC (sgACC, BA25), and pregenual ACC (pgACC, BA32). CT was estimated using the DiReCT (diffeomorphic registration-based cortical thickness) algorithm available in ANTs, with SPM12 segmentation as input.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Then, CT estimation was further performed by the DiReCT (diffeomorphic registration-based cortical thickness) algorithm available in ANTs (Advanced Normalization Tools)... We used the extended Human Connectome Project multimodal parcellation atlas of the human cortex and subcortical areas defining the ACC as Brodmann area (BA) 24 (dACC), BA 25 (sgACC), and BA 32 (pgACC).
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Wu2024.pdf.md: Methods and Materials / Brain Imaging; Imaging Data
